0.original: The researcher Claudian could use an adventurer's assistance in dispatching some bothersome birds.

1.original: Winged purveyors of death and destruction are wreaking havoc with Claudian's investigation of the ruins. Set handmade scarecrows at the specified locations in Highbridge.

2.original: The scarecrows have been placed. Inform Claudian that the avian pests will disrupt his research no more.

3.original: Now free to immerse himself in his research, Claudian thanks you for your assistance.

24.original: Set handmade scarecrows at the specified locations.

48.original: Do <hex:021A020203>not<hex:021A020103> look down, Claudian! You must not, you will not, you <hex:021A020203>can<hex:021A020103>not look─aaaaaahhh!

49.original: By the Twelve, my good <hex:02080FE905FF06776F6D616EFF046D616E03>, you frightened me half to death! But you must forgive me: I've been a bit restless of late, what with those winged nightmares swooping in from every which direction, pecking and poking and pricking at me.

50.original: I might as well pack up my instruments and go home, as I won't be getting an onze of research done. If, however, a kind adventurer like yourself were to use these scarecrows to drive the birds away, it would be another story. What do you say?

52.original: Do <hex:021A020203>not<hex:021A020103> look─oh, you've seen to the birds, have you? Splendid work, friend! Now to head back down and return to my research. Er, worry not, I'll be along any moment now─be on your way.
